items.name: Dobřejovice Special 2027
items.information:
# ENGLISH

**Mandatory Competition tutorial**

All competitors are required to complete the official competitor tutorial before being allowed to participate in the competition. This requirement applies to everyone, not only newcomers.
Competitors who do not attend the tutorial will not be permitted to compete.

**Special Competition Format**

This competition will be held using a special format in which all events run simultaneously.
Each competitor will have a 35-minute cumulative limit to complete attempts in any events they choose.
Each competitor in blindfolded events will have a 3-hour cumulative limit to complete attempts in any events they choose.


# ČESKY

**Povinný tutoriál pro soutěžící**

Všichni závodníci musí před začátkem soutěže absolvovat oficiální tutoriál. Tato povinnost platí pro všechny, nejen pro nováčky.
Závodníkům, kteří se tutoriálu nezúčastní, nebude umožněno soutěžit.

**Speciální formát soutěže**

Tato soutěž bude probíhat ve speciálním formátu, ve kterém všechny disciplíny běží zároveň.
Každý soutěžící má k dispozici 35 minut, během kterých může skládat libovolné disciplíny podle vlastního výběru.
Každý soutěžící v disciplínách poslepu má k dispozici 3 hodiny, během kterých může skládat libovolné disciplíny podle vlastního výběru.

items.name: Bolivia Nationals 2026
items.information:
🟥🟨🟩 **¡Bienvenidos al Campeonato Nacional de Bolivia 2026!** 🟥🟨🟩

Este campeonato celebra los 10 años desde que Bolivia organizó su primer Campeonato Nacional, un evento que dio inicio al crecimiento del speedcubing en nuestro país. Desde entonces, nuestra comunidad no ha dejado de crecer, reuniendo a personas de todas las edades y de diferentes regiones, unidas por la pasión por el Speedcubing, el desafío de superar sus propios tiempos y el de compañerismo que caracteriza a la comunidad del speedcubing.

Hoy queremos celebrar todo ese camino recorrido con una edición muy especial.

La inscripción está abierta para todos, sin importar la edad ni el lugar de donde vengan. ¡Anímate a ser parte de esta celebración y vive un campeonato que quedará en la historia del speedcubing en Bolivia!


 🟥🟨🟩 **¡Welcome to the Bolivia National Championship 2026!**   🟥🟨🟩
His championship celebrates 10 years since Bolivia hosted its very first National Championship, the event that helped kick off the growth of speedcubing in our country. Since then, our community has kept growing, bringing together people of all ages and from all over the country who share a passion for the Speedcubing, chasing new personal bests, and the amazing sense of community that makes speedcubing so special.

We're excited to celebrate this journey with a very special edition of the championship.

Registration is open to everyone, no matter your age or where you're from. Come join us, meet fellow cubers, and be part of a championship that will make speedcubing history in Bolivia!

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjA2MDQ0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--c0d143d39819bad425907a01d1201cca236592fa/BN26%20-%20WCA%20-%20%20Banner.png)

items.information:
**(Português) Brasileiro**
É com grande alegria que anunciamos mais um Capivara!

Decidimos continuar o formato do ano passado, com um dia apenas para modalidades silenciosas, e o segundo dia para as modalidades mais populares. Então pedimos para prestar bastante atenção às modalidades em que você está se inscrevendo.

Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento correto, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações abaixo em "Requisitos para inscrição" (e na hora da inscrição). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste [vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=hfp2rKaN8jHPI_RL).

É muito importante que você conheça todo o regulamento, que podem ser lido [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/).

Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para as modalidades 'Feminino' e 'Iniciante', que tomarão como referência a classificação geral na modalidade '3x3x3'.

**English**
We are really excited to announce a new Capivara!

We have decided to keep last year's format, with one day exclusively to silent events, and the second day for the most popular events. Therefore, we ask you to pay a lot of attention to the events you are registering to.

Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information below in "Registration requirements" (and during the registration). If you have any problem on how to register, take a look at this [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4yo7IqbcgOA).

It is very important that you know the regulations, which may be read [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards to the events 'Female' and 'Beginner', which will consider the final ranking in the '3x3x3' event.

**A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos:**

* Conhecer as regras da WCA, pois é uma competição oficial;
* Escolher os eventos a serem registrados com cuidado após revisar as guias Eventos e Cronograma. Preste atenção aos formatos das rodadas e seus cortes/limites;

* Being familiar with the WCA rules, since this is an official competition;

# Selamat Datang di Rapid Academy Indonesian Championship 2026!

Rapid Academy Indonesian Championship 2026 merupakan kejuaraan nasional speedcubing yang akan diadakan di Lippo Icon Gajah Mada, Jakarta. Kompetisi ini akan diadakan selama tiga hari dan terbuka untuk umum.

Setiap peserta diharapkan untuk memerhatikan time limit dan cut-off untuk setiap event karena diatur lebih ketat daripada kompetisi biasanya.

Setiap peserta wajib hadir 15 menit sebelum event yang diikuti dimulai. Jika peserta terlambat, maka panitia berhak mendiskualifikasi peserta tersebut.

**Pendaftaran on the spot TIDAK AKAN DITERIMA.**

**Catatan Penting:**
Terdapat batasan limit peserta untuk Event berikut:
* 3x3x3 Fewest Moves (terbatas untuk 24 pendaftar pertama)
* 4x4x4 Blindfolded (terbatas untuk 10 pendaftar pertama)
* 5x5x5 Blindfolded (terbatas untuk 10 pendaftar pertama)
* 3x3x3 Multi-Blind (terbatas untuk 20 pendaftar pertama)

Akan ada **3 jenis pemenang** dalam kompetisi ini:
* **Kategori Indonesia** - 3 pemenang teratas yang mewakili Indonesia di setiap kategori
* **Kategori Terbuka** - 3 pemenang teratas kompetisi tanpa memandang kewarganegaraan
* **Kategori Anak (Indonesia)** - Top 3 pemenang kompetisi untuk peserta berkewarganegaraan Indonesia berusia di bawah 13 tahun (per 01 November 2026) untuk event 3x3x3

Dengan mendaftar, peserta dan pendamping setuju bahwa penyelenggara, NSA, dan WCA tidak bertanggung jawab atas cedera pribadi atau kerusakan/kehilangan barang selama acara berlangsung.

Peserta akan mendapatkan Lanyard dan Name Tag.

Pastikan memantau jadwal selama periode pendaftaran terbuka jadwal dapat berubah tergantung jumlah pendaftar tiap event.

Silakan melakukan registrasi di laman [daftar](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IndonesianChampionship2026/register) dan konfirmasi di form ini: https://forms.gle/Yq4km6UVR2qt2Jnw7.
Jika Anda tidak dapat mengakses form tersebut, silakan mengirimkan bukti pembayaran registrasi ke email ini: [nlarchie1@gmail.com](mailto:nlarchie1@gmail.com). Dalam email tersebut, mohon tuliskan nama lengkap, WCA ID (jika Anda memilikinya), tanggal lahir, daftar event yang diikuti, dan bukti pembayaran.

-----------------------

# Welcome to Rapid Academy Indonesian Championship 2026!

Rapid Academy Indonesian Championship 2026 is the national speedcubing championship that will be held at Lippo Icon Gajah Mada, Jakarta. The competition will take place over three days and is open to the public.

All competitors are expected to pay close attention to the time limit and cut-off for each event, as they are set more strictly than in a typical competition.

All competitors must arrive 15 minutes before the event starts. If the competitor is late, the competitor will be disqualified.

**On the Spot registration WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED.**

**Important Notes:**
There are competitor limits for the following events:
* 3x3x3 Fewest Moves (limited to the first 24 registered competitors)
* 4x4x4 Blindfolded (limited to the first 10 registered competitors)
* 5x5x5 Blindfolded (limited to the first 10 registered competitors)
* 3x3x3 Multi-Blind (limited to the first 20 registered competitors)

There will be **3 categories of winners** in this competition:
* **Indonesian Category** - The top 3 Indonesian competitors in each event
* **Open Category** - The top 3 competitors overall, regardless of nationality
* **Kids Category (Indonesia)** - Top 3 winners of the competition among Indonesian citizens under 13 years of age (as of 01 November 2026) in the 3x3x3 event

By registering, competitors and their guests acknowledge that the organizers, the NSA, and the WCA are not responsible for any personal injury or any loss of or damage to personal belongings during the event.

All competitors will receive a Lanyard and a Name Tag.

Please check the competition schedule regularly during the registration period, as it may change depending on the number of registrations for each event.

Please register on the [register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IndonesianChampionship2026/register) page and confirm your registration by completing this form: https://forms.gle/Yq4km6UVR2qt2Jnw7.
If you cannot access the form, please submit your proof of payment for the registration to this email: [nlarchie1@gmail.com](mailto:nlarchie1@gmail.com). In the email, please write your full name, WCA ID (if you have it), date of birth, list of events, and the proof of payment.

### Deutsch

Herzlich willkommen zu Cottbus Cubing 2026!

Wir freuen uns sehr, euch alle zur zweiten offiziellen Speedcubing-Competition in der Lausitz begrüßen zu dürfen! Am Wochenende vom 06. bis 08. November wollen wir an den Erfolg des Vorjahres anknüpfen und Euch alle wieder herzlichst nach Cottbus einladen. Dieses Jahr möchten wir uns sogar noch steigern und gehen mit mehr Teilnehmenden und mehr Comp-Tagen an den Start. 

Wir wünschen allen Teilnehmenden spannende Wettkämpfe, faire Duelle und vor allem viel Freude am Würfeln!



**Bitte lies dir alle Tabs sorgfältig durch, damit du mit dem Ablaufplan und allen Modalitäten vertraut bist.**

### English

Welcome to the Cottbuser Cubing Competition!

We are delighted to welcome you all to the second official Speedcubing Competition in the Lausitz! From November 6th to 8th, we aim to build on last year's success and happily want to invite you all to Cottbus once again. This year, we want to surpass even that, with more participants and more competition days.

We wish all participants exciting solves, fair competition, and – above all – lots of fun with the cubes!



**Please read all tabs carefully so you are familiar with the schedule and all modalities.**

**Deutsch:**
Wir freuen uns sehr die ersten Austrian Nationals ankündigen zu dürfen!

Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Felizian Baumgartner, Julian Ostadal, Lukas Schwarz, Marcel Niedl, Noah Kirrane, Phillip Leimer, Simon Praschl und Thomas Strasser  und delegiert von Fabian Staber, Florian Truckenthanner, Jeremia E. Neuhold, Pranjal Khan und Viktor Kalmar. Die Championship wird im Großen Saal und Turnsaal der Pfarre Akkonplatz stattfinden. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt.

Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen!

Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen.

Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich!

**English:**
We are happy to announce the first ever Austrian Nationals!

The speedcubing competition is organised by Felizian Baumgartner, Julian Ostadal, Lukas Schwarz, Marcel Niedl, Noah Kirrane, Phillip Leimer, Simon Praschl and Thomas Strasser and delegated by Fabian Staber, Florian Truckenthanner, Jeremia E. Neuhold, Pranjal Khan and Viktor Kalmar. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings.

The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations.

Every Competitor can bring one guest.

items.name: Salonica Autumn Open 2026
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjExMDYzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2b39acc8afc2f42f3a6da807026b51e138f0abec/image.png)

**SALONICA AUTUMN OPEN 2026**
Το ετήσιο ραντεβού μας στη Θεσσαλονίκη επιστρέφει!

Στις 24 και 25 Οκτωβρίου 2026, όλοι οι Cubers συναντιόμαστε ξανά για έναν μεγάλο διήμερο διαγωνισμό γεμάτο ταχύτητα, συναγωνισμό και όμορφες στιγμές.

Το Salonica Autumn Open 2026 θα αποτελέσει ταυτόχρονα τον δεύτερο διαγωνισμό της **GREEK CUBING LEAGUE**!
Τα μέλη της GREEK CUBING LEAGUE (https://greekcubingleague.gr) θα έχουν **επιστροφή 7€** στην κάρτα τους, αμέσως μόλις οριστικοποιηθεί η εγγραφή τους κατά την ολοκλήρωση των εγγράφων. 

Ετοιμαστείτε για ακόμη ένα αξέχαστο cubing Σαββατοκύριακο! Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε στην γιορτή του cubing!

Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. 

Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στη σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. 

Δείτε αυτά τα βίντεο για να είστε ετοιμασμένοι:

[Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg)

[Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων.](https://youtu.be/x5KaXXoh7XI)

**SALONICA AUTUMN OPEN 2026**
Our annual meetup in Thessaloniki is back!

On October 24 and 25, 2026, all Cubers gather once again for a major two-day competition packed with speed, friendly rivalry, and great moments.

Salonica Autumn Open 2026 will also serve as the second competition of the **GREEK CUBING LEAGUE**!
Members of the GREEK CUBING LEAGUE (https://greekcubingleague.gr) will receive **a €7 refund** back to their card as soon as their registration is finalized upon completing the registration process.

Get ready for another unforgettable cubing weekend! Grab your cubes, gear up, read the rules, and join the cubing celebration!

Please read the following pages carefully to find all the necessary information.

Note: For a registration to be considered complete, you must complete the registration process on the competition's WCA page AND pay the participation fee using your bank card through the Stripe payment platform used by the WCA, as described in the adjacent tabs.

## [EN]

### Registration Reminders

**Registration will close on Tuesday October 6th, 2026 at 8pm (12 days before the competition)**. You must register and pay the registration fee before this date in order for your registration to be accepted. Late registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. If you have any questions, please contact us using the *Contact Organization team* link at the top of this page.

### Ottawa Side Events Series

This competition is in a series with [Ottawa Side Events A 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OttawaSideEventsA2026). You will only be able to compete in one of these two competitions. Attempting to register for both competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.

### Competitor Requirements

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). For a summary of the most important regulations, please refer to the following resources: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0).

If you are a new competitor, this video explains what to expect at your first competition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY).

### Mailing List

Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

### Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

## [FR]

### Rappels concernant l'inscription

**Les inscriptions seront clôturées le mardi 6 octobre 2026 à 20h (12 jours avant la compétition)**. Vous devez vous inscrire et payer les frais d'inscription avant cette date pour que votre inscription soit acceptée. Les inscriptions en retard ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails. Si vous avez des questions, veuillez nous contacter en utilisant le lien *Contact Équipe organisatrice* en haut de cette page.

### Série de Ottawa Side Events

Cette compétition fait partie d'une série avec [Ottawa Side Events A 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OttawaSideEventsA2026). Vous ne pourrez participer qu'à une seule de ces deux compétitions. Si vous tentez de vous inscrire aux deux compétitions, une seule de vos inscriptions sera acceptée.

### Exigences pour les compétiteurs

Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les compétiteurs doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Pour un résumé des règlements les plus importants, veuillez vous référer aux ressources suivantes: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [Les bases d'une compétition officielle WCA](https://youtu.be/LH3QG7krdgc?si=zHT9ze8Wlfopxkr2).

Pour les nouveaux compétiteurs, cette vidéo explique à quoi s'attendre lors de votre première compétition: [À quoi s'attendre pour votre première compétition](https://youtu.be/yYZHzTc0GMc?si=L4lK3I42zL1eMo9j).

### Liste de diffusion

Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr)  sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou [vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions.

### Avis de droit à l'image

Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

**¡Celebremos juntos los 10 años del SpeedCube Baja Open!**

El torneo más icónico de Baja California regresa en 2026 para conmemorar una década desde aquella primera competencia en 2016. Durante estos 10 años, SpeedCube Baja Open ha sido escenario de récords, emoción y la unión de la comunidad cubera.  
Esta es una competencia avalada por la WCA, por lo que todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [reglamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/).

**AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA**  
En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing y Baja Cubing con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades.  
Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad.  
📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

**Let’s celebrate 10 years of SpeedCube Baja Open!**

The most iconic tournament in Baja California returns in 2026 to commemorate a decade since the very first competition in 2016. Over these 10 years, SpeedCube Baja Open has been the stage for records, excitement, and the unity of the cubing community.   
This is a WCA sanctioned competition, so all competitors must be familiar with the [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

**NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY**  
Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by the Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing and Baja Cubing for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities.  
By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice.  
📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

items.name: Penn Cube Day Fall 2026
items.information:
# Registration has closed due to a large waiting list. We will not be accepting any new registrations at this time.

* We will be giving out free Penn Cube Day note books for competitors.

* Current UPenn students and faculty are entitled to free registration. Please leave your Penn email in the registration comment and pay the fee. We will refund if you are qualified.

* We will have newcomer (competitors attending their first competition) podium for 3×3, based on the result of 3×3 round 1.

* We recommend that you arrive at least 15 minutes before your first event because there are no set times for each group. If your first event is later in the day, you do not have to arrive until then. Missing your group risks potential disqualification from the event.

* Groups will be posted and sent in an email a few days before the competition. When it is time to compete, groups will be called instead of individual participants.

* Food and drinks are NOT permitted inside the main room. You may eat elsewhere in Houston Hall. There are a few restaurants within a ten minute walk/drive.

* Live results will be posted on WCA Live.

items.name: Bergen Open 2026
items.information:
### 🇳🇴 Informasjon
Velkommen til Bergen Open. Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta.

##### Nye Deltakere
Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BergenOpen2026#77513-nye-konkurrenter-new-competitors).

##### On The Spot Registreringer
Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Dette er også helt gratis. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BergenOpen2024/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen.

---

### 🇺🇸 Information
Welcome to to Bergen Open! This competition is open to everyone who wants to compete.

There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BergenOpen2026#77513-nye-konkurrenter-new-competitors) tab.

##### On The Spot Registration
Competitors may register on the spot for free aswell. We still strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/bergenopen2026/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot.

items.information:
##### 🇧🇷
Seja bem vindo ao **Cascavel ao Cubo 2026**! Instruções de participação:

* Todas as informações sobre inscrição no evento podem ser encontradas na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CascavelaoCubo2026/register).
* As inscrições vão até o dia **02/10/2026**, ou até que o **limite de 50 competidores** seja atingido. Após essa data, só será possível a inscrição no dia do campeonato, caso haja vagas remanescentes.
* Chegue ao local da competição, com seu cubo em mãos, no mínimo 30 minutos antes do horário de qualquer modalidade que você participará.
* Todos os participantes devem ler o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) antes da competição.
* O cubo com o qual você vai competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele. Caso contrário, o cubo pode não ser aceito para a competição.
* Não há idade mínima ou máxima para participação, mas competidores menores de 18 anos só podem participar com a presença de um responsável legal.
* Todos os competidores devem apresentar documento válido com foto no credenciamento.
* Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. Mande suas dúvidas para para o e-mail da organização (cascavelaocubo@gmail.com), e faremos o melhor possível para ajudar. Sempre há espaço para novos competidores!
* Divirta-se!

---

##### 🇺🇸
Welcome to **Cascavel ao Cubo 2026**! Participation instructions:

* All information regarding registration can be found in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CascavelaoCubo2026/register) tab.
* Registration closes on **10/02/2026**, or whenever the **limit of 50 competitors** is reached. After that, it will only be possible to register for the 3x3x3 Cube event, in the day of the competition, if there are still vacancies.
* Be present at the competition venue, in possession of your cube, at least 30 minutes earlier for any event you are participating.
* All participants must read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.
* The cube with which you will compete must be in good condition, so take good care of it. Otherwise, your cube may not be approved for the competition.
* There is no minimum or maximum age for participation, but underage competitors can only participate with the presence of a legal guardian.
* All competitors must present a valid document at the check-in.
* If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. You can e-mail your questions to the organization (cascavelaocubo@gmail.com), and we will do our best to help you. There is always room for new speedcubers!
* Have fun!

 Уся актуальна інформація щодо реєстрації, розкладу, правил, можливих змін та інших організаційних питань публікуватиметься в Telegram-групі заходу.

Speed ​​​​Rubik's Cube Competition in Support of Ukraine 🇺🇦
We invite everyone who wants to take part in the speed Rubik's Cube competition - an event that will unite speedcubing enthusiasts for a good cause.
This is not only an opportunity to test your skills, compete with the strongest participants and spend time in a friendly atmosphere, but also to support Ukraine. Together we prove that every move matters, and unity makes us stronger.
All relevant information regarding registration, schedule, rules, possible changes and other organizational issues will be published in the Telegram group of the event.
Solve it quickly. Support Ukraine. Together to victory! 💙💛

items.information:
## 🇳🇴 Informasjon
Velkommen til Trondheim Høst 2026! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta.

### On The Spot Registreringer
Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimHost2026/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen.

### Førstegangsdeltakere
Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimHost2026#78798-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors).


---

## 🇺🇸 Information
Welcome to Trondheim Høst 2026! The competition is open to all who wish to compete.

### On The Spot Registration
Competitors may register on the spot. We strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimHost2026/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot.

### First-Time Competitors
First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimHost2026#78798-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab.

items.information:
(HR)

Croatian Quiet Championship 2026 je natjecanje koje se održava u Zagrebu. Bilo tko može sudjelovati, bez obzira na nacionalnost i starost. Preporučujemo da budete upoznati s WCA Pravilnikom.

Budući da se FMC i discipline slaganja naslijepo ne nalaze na [Croatian Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CroatianChampionship2026), ovo je Vaša prilika da postanete Hrvatski prvak u tim disciplinama.

Nagrade za najbolja 3 hrvata će biti dodijeljene na svečanoj ceremoniji u Petrinji tjedan dana kasnije.

*Ne morate se natjecati na Croatian Championshipu kako bi ste se natjecali na ovom natjecanju.*

Za više informacija, proučite ostale kartice na stranici natjecanja.

**NAPOMENA - NA OVOM NATJECANJU SE NEĆE ODRŽATI KLASIČNE DISCIPLINE KAO NPR. 3X3X3 KOCKA**

(EN)

Croatian Quiet Championship 2026 is a competition that will take place in Zagreb. Anyone may participate, regardless of nationality or age. We recommend that all competitors become familiar with the WCA Regulations.

Since FMC and blindfolded events will not be held at [Croatian Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CroatianChampionship2026), this is your chance to become the Croatian champion in those events.

Awards for the top 3 Croatian competitors will be presented at the ceremony in Petrinja one week later.

*You do not have to compete at Croatian Championship to take part in this competition.*

For more information, please check the other tabs on the competition page.

**NOTE: THIS COMPETITION WILL NOT INCLUDE REGULAR EVENTS SUCH AS THE 3X3X3 CUBE.**

# Español

Hay desafíos que no se vencen solo con velocidad; se dominan con la capacidad de visualizar lo que otros no pueden.

**Megaminx** es una prueba de estrategia, creatividad y control bajo presión. Es el eje de esta competencia.

Pero **Mega-Mente** es mucho más que un solo rompecabezas. Cada categoría ha sido seleccionada para ponerte a prueba. **¿Tienes lo necesario para adaptarte a cualquier desafío?**

Porque no importa qué tan rápido gires un cubo. Lo que importa es...
**qué tan lejos puedas llevar tu mente.**

#### **¡BIENVENIDOS A MEGA-MENTE PUEBLA 2026!**

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Esta competencia es posible gracias al apoyo del Presidente de **"Red Jóvenes X México Puebla"**, **Juan Carlos Quiroz**.

 Mega-Mente Puebla 2026 es una competencia oficial de la WCA, por lo que **todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [Reglamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/)**.
​
**AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA**
En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades.
Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad.
📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/


# English
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Some challenges can't be conquered by speed alone; they are mastered through the ability to visualize what others cannot.

**Megaminx** is a test of strategy, creativity, and composure under pressure. It is the centerpiece of this competition.

But **Mega-Mente** is much more than a single puzzle. Every event has been carefully chosen to challenge you. **Do you have what it takes to adapt to every challenge?**

Because it doesn't matter how fast you can turn a cube. What matters is...
**how far you can push your mind.**

#### **WELCOME TO MEGA-MENTE PUEBLA 2026!**

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

This competition is made possible thanks to the support of the President of **"Red Jóvenes X México Puebla"**, **Juan Carlos Quiroz**.

 Mega-Mente Puebla 2026 is an official WCA competition, so **all competitors must be familiar with the [Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations)**.

**NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY**
Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities.
By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice.
📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

### Outside Food not permitted###
This venue does **not** allow anyone to bring outside food or drinks in. Bringing in water is allowed. The venue's concession will be open. We apologize for the inconvenience and we thank you for your cooperation.

**Registration Reminders**
You must register and pay the registration fee before your registration can be accepted. **Unpaid registrations will not be accepted**. 
​
Since this is a "favourites" competition, you may choose **at most five (5) events**.
​
Please review all of the tabs listed on this website. Attendance is not required for the entire competition. However, **please arrive at least 15 minutes before the events that you compete in or help in are planned to start**. Please bring your own puzzles for the events you are competing in.
​
Once your registration has been accepted, you will no longer be able to change your events by yourself. If you would like to change them, send the organization team an email and we will change your events for you as long as you inform us before September 11, 2026 at 6:00 PM MST.
​
**First-Time Competitors: All newcomers must be familiar with the WCA Regulations before competing.** There is a video [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww&t=2s&ab_channel=cyotheking) for a basic overview of the rules.

Attendees of competitions consent to their images being used by SpeedCubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

# 본 대회는 3x3x3 종목이 없습니다.

WCA 공인 대회에 처음 참가 하신다면, 참가 신청 전에 [첫 참가자 안내](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AnsanAutumn2026#78780-for-new-competitors) 탭과 [자주 묻는 질문](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AnsanAutumn2026#78779-frequently-asked-questions) 탭을 확인하십시오.

모든 참가자가 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/)을 숙지할 것을 강력히 권장합니다.

WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다.

원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [대회 참가 안내 영상](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc)을 시청하여 주십시오.

원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오.

___

# There is no 3x3x3 event at this competition.

If this is your first official WCA competition, please read the [For New Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AnsanAutumn2026#78780-for-new-competitors) tab and the [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AnsanAutumn2026#78779-frequently-asked-questions) tab before registering.

All competitors are strongly encouraged to be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

Due to WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties at the organizers' request.

Please watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc) to get familiar with WCA official competitions.

Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz) to get familiar with staff duties.

items.name: Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown II 2026

venue.name: [Swiss Games Museum](https://museedujeu.ch/)
venue.details: On the ground floor, entrance through the court

items.information:
Le Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown fait partie de la [Swisscubing Cup 2026](https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2026/), qui se compose de plusieurs compétitions réparties sur toute l'année.
Tout le monde est le bienvenu, que vous souhaitiez ou non participer à la finale de la Swisscubing Cup.

Pour cette compétition, **les points de qualification pour la finale de la Swisscubing Cup 2026 ne peuvent être cumulés que dans les disciplines suivantes :
3BLD, 4BLD, 5BLD, Multi-Blind et FMC.**
Toutes les autres disciplines présentes lors de cette compétition ne font pas partie de la Swisscubing Cup.

**Note aux débutants :**
Cette compétition s'adresse prioritairement aux compétiteurs expérimentés et est organisée en conséquence. Bien que les débutants soient les bienvenus, l'expérience montre que peu d'autres néophytes participent à ce tournoi spécifique. Pour une première expérience en compétition, un tournoi plus "accessible" est souvent un choix plus agréable.

__________________________

Der Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown ist Teil des [Swisscubing Cup 2026](https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2026/). Dieser besteht aus mehreren Competitions über das ganze Jahr verteilt. 
Jeder ist willkommen, unabhängig davon ob Interesse besteht, am Swisscubing Cup Finale teilzunehmen.
**Punkte für die Qualifikation für das Swisscubing Cup 2026 Finale können bei dieser Competition nur in den folgenden Disziplinen gesammelt werden:
3BLD, 4-Blind, 5-Blind, Multiblind, FMC.**
Alle anderen Disziplinen an dieser Competition sind nicht Teil des Swisscubing Cups.

**Hinweis für Neulinge:**
Diese Competition richtet sich in erster Linie an erfahrene Speedcuber und ist entsprechend organisiert. Zwar sind Neulinge willkommen, an diesem Turnier nehmen erfahrungsgemäss nur wenige andere Einsteiger teil. Für den ersten Competition-Besuch ist ein einsteigerfreundlicheres Turnier oft die angenehmere Wahl. 

______________________________________________________________________________________________

Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown is part of the [Swisscubing Cup 2026](https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2026/), made of multiple competitions during the whole year. 
Everyone is welcome to compete, regardless of whether they are interested in taking part in the Swisscubing Cup final.

**Points for qualifying for the Swisscubing Cup 2026 Finals can only be collected at this competition in the following events: 
3BLD, 4-Blind, 5-Blind, Multiblind, FMC.**
All other events at this competition are not part of the Swisscubing Cup.

**Note for newcomers:**
This competition is primarily aimed at experienced speedcubers. While newcomers are welcome, there will be only a small number of other beginners attending this event. For a first competition, a more beginner-friendly event is often the more enjoyable choice.

items.information:
**Español**

Esta es la primera competencia organizada en esta sede y también será la primera competencia oficial del año en Quetzaltenango.

Kukulcán Open 2026 será una competencia oficial de la World Cube Association (WCA), inspirada en la cultura maya y en la figura de Kukulcán, uno de los símbolos más representativos de Mesoamérica.

Nuestro objetivo es ofrecer una experiencia competitiva de alta calidad, promoviendo la comunidad del speedcubing en el occidente de Guatemala y mostrando parte de nuestra identidad y cultura a todos los participantes.

Esta competencia se llevará a cabo en dos locaciones diferentes.

Para consultar la ubicación correspondiente a cada día, revisa la pestaña “Distribución de áreas / Venue Layout”, donde se indica la ubicación de la competencia para el viernes 11, así como para los días sábado 12 y domingo 13.

¡Sean todos bienvenidos a Quetzaltenango y esperamos que disfruten de Kukulcán Open 2026!


**English**

This is the first competition organized at this venue and also the first official WCA competition of the year in Quetzaltenango.

Kukulcán Open 2026 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) competition inspired by the Mayan culture and Kukulcán, one of the most iconic symbols of Mesoamerica.

Our goal is to provide a high-quality competition while helping grow the speedcubing community in western Guatemala and sharing part of our culture and identity with every participant.

This competition will take place at two different venues.

Please refer to the “Distribución de áreas / Venue Layout” tab to find the competition location for Friday the 11th, as well as for Saturday the 12th and Sunday the 13th.

Welcome to Quetzaltenango—we hope you enjoy Kukulcán Open 2026!

Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste [Guia para competidores novatos](https://docs.google.com/document/d/19vX1Rr681jMj1dmgBmOoBVpgT8KutJ_JmzuVoJK_R30/edit?usp=sharing).

​
Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para o feminino e para iniciantes na modalidade 'Cubo 3x3x3' (que tomarão como base a classificação geral na primeira rodada).

Após o término do prazo das inscrições, serão aceitas inscrições no local do campeonato apenas na modalidade 3x3x3, no valor de R$ 35,00. O Competidor deverá chegar com 30 minutos de antecedência e a inscrição só será aceita caso ainda haja vagas.

---
​

​
🇺🇸 Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DoisVizinhosOpen2026/register) tab. ​
Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.
​
There will be awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards for female competitors and for beginners in the '3x3x3 Cube' event (which will be based on the ranking of the first round).

After the registration period ends, registrations will be accepted at the competition venue only for the 3x3x3 event, for BRL 35.00. Competitors must arrive 30 minutes in advance and registration will only be accepted if there are still registration slots available.

This competition is open to everyone, but only New York residents are eligible for New York champion titles - see the Championship Eligibility tab for more info.

There are **separate registration limits** for each event. Out of courtesy for other competitors, please only register for events that you actually plan to compete in. If every individual event has already reached its limit, no further registrations will be accepted, even if the overall limit of 60 hasn't been reached.

4BLD, 5BLD, MBLD: 30 competitors each
5x5, 6x6, 7x7, 3BLD, FMC: 40 competitors each

Please avoid bringing unnecessary guests, especially on Days 2 and 3, to help the competition stay quiet.
The Harry & Thelma Adler Community Room is located on the 4th floor in front of the Ice Skating Rink on your right hand side.

###### Español
¡Bienvenidos al Mololoa Open 2026, otra competencia en el hermoso estado de **Nayarit**!. Este evento emocionante y lleno de velocidad se llevará a cabo en la ciudad de Tepic los días sábado 29 y domingo 30 de agosto de 2026.

El Mololoa Open 2026 reunirá a cuberos de todo el estado de Nayarit y más allá, brindándoles la oportunidad de mostrar su destreza y competir en una variedad de eventos. Tanto si eres un principiante como un profesional experimentado, este torneo ofrece una oportunidad para que todos participen y se diviertan.

Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial del Cubo. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia.

En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades.
Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad.
📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

###### English
Welcome to Mololoa Open 2026, another competition in the beautiful state of **Nayarit**! This exciting and high-speed event will take place in the city of Tepic on Saturday, Aug 29, and Sunday, Aug 30, 2026.

Mololoa Open 2026 will bring together cubers from across the state of Nayarit and beyond, providing them with the opportunity to showcase their skills and compete in a variety of events. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced professional, this tournament offers a chance for everyone to participate and have fun.

This competition is recognized as an official event by the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.

**NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY**
Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities.

## Welcome to the Kewbz UK Championship 2026!
### This year's UK National Championship!

#### Please read ALL tabs before registering.

##### Spectators are welcome to attend for free. There's no need to pre-book - feel free to drop in whenever you wish!

**Free T-Shirt:** By registering and attending the Kewbz UK Championship 2026, you'll receive a Kewbz UK Championship 2026 T-shirt as a memento! **Please fill in your registration comment with your T-shirt size.**

**Newcomers:** This competition is open to first-time competitors, who will only be able to compete in 3x3, 2x2, Pyraminx, Skewb, and 3x3 One-Handed. If you would like to attempt to qualify for other events, you must do so another competition first. You can see all upcoming UK competitions [here](https://wca.ukca.org).

**Qualification Requirements:** If you do not meet the qualification requirements outlined in the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzUKChampionship2026#competition-events) in an official WCA competition by August 16th you will not be eligible to compete in those events. You will not be able to add events to your registration which you do not qualify for, but can update your registration if you later qualify for them. Please note that **there are no qualifications for 3x3, 2x2, Pyraminx, Skewb, or 3x3 One-Handed.**

**Final Round Advancements:** The top 8 UK competitors will be guaranteed to progress into the finals for all events. In 3x3, any non-UK competitors faster than the 8th UK competitor will compete together, before UK competitors face off in seeded pairs. In other events, all 16 finalists will compete together, with the [top 8 UK competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#9p2b) being joined by the 8 remaining best competitors from any region.

**Fewest Moves, 4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5 Blindfolded, 3x3 Multi-Blind:** These events will **not** be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for these events, you must compete at the [Kewbz UK Championship FMC 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzUKChampionshipFMC2026) or the [Kewbz UK Blindfolded Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzUKBLDChampionship2026). The podium winners of these competition will be awarded their prize during the awards at Kewbz UK Championship 2026.

**Prizes Eligiblity:** As this is the UK National Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete.

**Filming and Photography:** Filming and photography will take place at the event. By entering the event premises, you acknowledge that you have been informed you may be photographed and recorded for media to be used by the UKCA and its partners.

English version is below
Deutsch:
Wir freuen uns sehr euch Langenstein Summer 2026 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können.

Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Simon Praschl, Martin Fröhlich, Philipp Leimer, Thomas Strasser und Speedcubing Austria - sowie delegiert von Pranjal Khan, Fabian Staber und Jan Křížka. Diesmal findet die Competition in der Eisstockhalle in Langenstein statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt.

Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen!

Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen.

Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich!

English:
We are happy to announce the Langenstein Summer 2026 as an official WCA Competition.

The speedcubing competition is organised by Simon Praschl, Martin Fröhlich, Philipp Leimer and Thomas Strasser and delegated by Pranjal Khan, Fabian Staber and Jan Křížka. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings.

The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations.

Every Competitor can bring one guest.

## 🇳🇴 (NB) Informasjon
Velkommen til norgesmesterskapet i kubing 2026, denne gangen tilbake i Trondheim. Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta, uavhengig av nasjonalitet.

### Førstegangsdeltakere
Førstegangsdeltakere er hjertelig velkommen til å delta på NM. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen]
(https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2026#74970-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors).

---

## 🇳🇴 (NN) Informasjon
Velkomen til noregsmeisterskapen i kubing, som er tilbake i Trondheim i år. Konkurransen er open for alle som ynskjer å delta, uavhengig av nasjonalitet.

### Førstegongsdeltakarar
Førstegongsdeltakarar er hjarteleg velkomne til å delta på NM. Det blir ikkje stilt krav om kor rask ein må vere for å delta, og vi ynskjer å sjå flest mogeleg velje å delta. Vi oppmodar alle førstegongsdeltakarar til å lese [fana for førstegongsdeltakarar](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2026#74970-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors).

---

## 🇬🇧 Information
Welcome to the Norwegian Cubing Championship of 2026, this time back in Trondheim. The competition is open to all who wish to compete regardless of nationality.

### First-Time Competitors
First-time competitors are very welcome to compete in the Norwegian Championship. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2026#74970-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab.

items.information:

The highest placing British Columbia resident in each event will be recognized as the **2026 BC Champion**. Check out the [BC Champion Eligibility](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BCChampionship2026#66713-bc-champion-eligibility) tab for more information.

### Hawaii's first ever state championship is here!

All competitors are welcome to attend and compete. Only Hawaiian residents will be eligible for the title of Hawaii State Champion. More information can be found on the [State Champion Eligibility](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/HawaiiChampionship2026#67164-state-champion-eligibility) tab.

---

##### Different days will have different events. The following days will hold the following events:
* Friday: 3x3 Fewest Moves, 4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5 Blindfolded, 3x3 MultiBlind
* Saturday: 3x3, 2x2, 4x4, 3x3 One-Handed, Pyraminx, Skewb
* Sunday: 5x5, 6x6, 7x7, 3x3 Blindfolded, Clock, Megaminx, Square-1, Face Turning Octahedron

**You are not required to be present on days you will not be competing.**

---

* It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
* Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8) will provide you with most of the information you need.
* If you are a first time competitor it is highly encouraged to be present for the competitor tutorial on Saturday at 9:00 AM.

#![Bandera ESP](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb0E5IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--c7812c9b5d2929fb4ed7644517bf4f9800a3d1e4/esp.png)
* Los socios de la AES (Asociación Española de Speedcubing) recibirán un descuento del 15%. Puedes hacerte socio de la AES [aquí](https://speedcubingspain.org/register/).
* Los socios de la AGS  (Asociación Galega de Speedcubing) recibirán un descuento del 15%. Puedes hacerte socio de la [AGS](https://www.galiciaspeedcubing.org/) de forma presencial en el campeonato.

Para los descuentos, el pago se debe hacer como todos los competidores y tras la competición se devolverá el importe de los descuentos.

Al registrarte en esta competición aceptas que se te enviarán correos electrónicos informativos y se te podrá solicitar confirmación de asistencia mediante correo electrónico. **Si no se recibe dicha confirmación, tu registro puede ser anulado sin reembolso.**

Por favor, leed los correos que os enviemos antes de la competición ya que pueden contener información **importante**. Además, todos los competidores deben leer las pestañas de [Información Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VigoOpen2026#72861-informacion-importante-important-information) y de Preguntas Más Frecuentes ([PMF](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VigoOpen2026#72860-preguntas-frecuentes-faq) para el correcto desarrollo de la competición.

Un registro se considera completo una vez se ha realizado el pago correspondiente. Los registros completos serán aceptados manualmente en orden de pago y aparecerán en la lista de competidores hasta alcanzar el límite de competidores. Una vez alcanzado este límite los registros completos serán añadidos a la [lista de espera](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VigoOpen2026#72865-lista-de-espera-waiting-list).


#![Bandera GAL](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTk1NDY2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--1d55857fc84f004f1a94c2a3ddbc1ad3a591c62f/1F3F4-E0065-E0073-E0067-E0061-E007F_color.png)
* Os socios da AES (Asociación Española de Speedcubing) recibirán un desconto do 15%. Podes facerte socio da AES aquí.
* Os socios da AGS (Asociación Galega de Speedcubing) recibirán un desconto do 15%. Podes facerte socio da AGS de forma presencial no campionato.

Para aplicar os descontos, o pago debe facerse igual que o resto dos competidores e, despois da competición, devolverase o importe correspondente aos descontos.

Ao rexistrarte nesta competición aceptas que se che enviarán correos electrónicos informativos e que se che poderá solicitar confirmación de asistencia mediante correo electrónico. Se non se recibe esa confirmación, o teu rexistro pode ser anulado sen reembolso.

Por favor, lede os correos que vos enviemos antes da competición, xa que poden conter información importante. Ademais, todos os competidores deben ler as lapelas de Información Importante e de Preguntas Máis Frecuentes (PMF) para o correcto desenvolvemento da competición.

Un rexistro considérase completo unha vez realizado o pago correspondente. Os rexistros completos serán aceptados manualmente por orde de pago e aparecerán na lista de competidores ata acadar o límite establecido. Unha vez alcanzado este límite, os rexistros completos serán engadidos á lista de espera.


#![Bandera UK](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb0U5IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2a28e3c285bf55a2606838971abb0514d0ef172c/UK.png)
* The AES members (Spanish Association) will receive a 15% discount. You can become a member of the AES [here](https://speedcubingspain.org/register/).
* The AGS members (Galician Association) will receive a 15% discount. You can become a member of the [AGS](https://www.galiciaspeedcubing.org/) at the competition. 

For discounts, the payment must be made as all other competitors and after the competition the discounts will be returned.

By registering to this competition you accept that informative emails will be sent to you and you might be asked for an attendance confirmation via email. **If said confirmation is not received, your registration may be deleted without refund.**

This competition brings together the nation's top talents for an exciting showcase of skill, determination, and sportsmanship.

Only the **top three** winners representing the **Philippines** of each category will receive physical awards such as medals and plaques.
The top three winners of any Finals, regardless of nationality, will be recognized together with the top three at the awarding ceremony.

# Welcome to **Greenwoods Big Blind and Beyond 2026**!
# 
This competition features **4BLD** as the main event and will take place right after **[FMC World 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCWorld2026)** in the morning. It is also the **first competition in the Philippines to feature two rounds of 4BLD**.

The competition includes official events such as **7x7, Clock, 3BLD, and MBLD,** with a focus on big cubes and blindfolded events. **No 3x3 event will be held**, as this competition is designed for specialists in quiet events.

Unofficial events include **Master Magic** and **Pyraminx One-Handed**. Please check the **[Unofficial Events](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GBBB2026#74010-unofficial-events-info-registration)** tab for more details.

This competition marks the third Greenwoods competition of the year, following **[Greenwoods Clock Clash 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GreenwoodsClockClash2026)** and **[Greenwoods Summer Overtime 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GreenwoodsSummerOvertime2026)**, continuing the series of uniquely themed events in the community.

We encourage all competitors and guests to review the information tabs for details on the **schedule, regulations, venue guidelines**, and **registration** to help ensure a smooth and well-organized competition.

We look forward to seeing you—join us for a day of focused, quiet solving, where blindfolds are on and every solve is all about memory and precision.

## Blindfolded Events Only

The only events at this competition are ***blindfolded events***, which require a significant amount of practice and concentration. All attendees, including competitors and guests, are asked to please remain quiet at this competition to allow competitors to concentrate.

## FMC World 2026

[FMC World 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCWorld2026) (Waterloo location) will take place at the same venue. If you are registering for both competitions, **you must register for each competition separately**.

### Note for New Competitors

Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they know how to solve puzzles **blindfolded** (please note Regulation [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)), this might not be the best experience for new competitors. Please consider registering for [another competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) if this one isn't for you.

### Mailing List

Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](http://speedcubingcanada.org) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. Thank you for your patience during this time as we work to scale up to the exciting growth of the cubing community.

### Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

This competition will be the highest from ground level ever held in the World. This claim derives from our own research and is not an official measure from the WCA as the WCA does not track elevation or altitude as an official statistic.
The competition will be held on the 45th floor of the hotel at 189m from ground level.

Välkomna till Take Your Time Bergshamra 2026! **Notera att tävlingen hålls i Bergshamra utanför Norrtälje, inte Bergshamra norr om centrala Stockholm!**

Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. 

Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information.

**OBS:** Grenarna 6x6x6, 7x7x7 och Megaminx kan **inte** kombineras med grenarna 3x3x3 BLD, 4x4x4 BLD och 5x5x5 BLD. Detta innebär att du exempelvis **inte** kan ställa upp i både Megaminx och 3x3x3 BLD, men att du kan ställa upp i både Megaminx och 7x7x7.

**OBS:** Maximalt en gäst / medföljande per deltagare på grund av tävlingslokalens storlek. Ingen utomstående publik tillåten.

-----

Welcome to Take Your Time Bergshamra 2026!

Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience.

We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information.

**NOTE:** The 6x6x6, 7x7x7 and Megaminx events **can not** be combined with the 3x3x3 BLD, 4x4x4 BLD and 5x5x5 BLD events. This means that, for example, you **can not** enter both Megaminx and 3x3x3 BLD, but you can enter both Megaminx and 7x7x7.

**NOTE:** Maximum one guest / accompanying person per competitors due to the size of the competition venue. No external visitors allowed.

* Enviar comprovante de pagamento para o e-mail renan.cunha20@gmail.com. **Inscriçoes so serão confirmadas após o envio do comprovante.**
* Outras informações adicionais verifique no site da WCA ou entre em contato com o organizador através do e-mail (aline.cucick@sesisp.org.br), bem como o delegado por meio do e-mail (mcasassa@worldcubeassociation.org).

OBS.: Alunos e Associados do SESI estão isentos da taxa de insrição, mas devem Informar que são alunos do SESI no campo INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS durante o ato da inscrição.
# REGISTRATION
### ATTENTION: Register on the MeuSESI website to access SESI facilities. You can register by [clicking here](https://meusesi.sesisp.org.br/Reserva/0ee4eb94-ec6f-4490-b47e-08dea9de73cd)

**The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements:**
* Being familiar with the WCA rules, since this is an official competition;
* Carefully choosing the events. Keep the rounds format, cutoffs and limits in mind.
* Register through the WCA website.The registration fee is R$15,00 paid in advance by bank transfer or Pix. Registration at competition day will not be allowed. **Pix renan.cunha20@gmail.com**
* Send proof of payment to renan.cunha20@gmail.com. **Registrations must be confirmed after sending the voucher.**
* For additional information, check the WCA website or contact the organizer via email, (aline.cucick@sesisp.org.br), or the delegate via email (mcasassa@worldcubeassociation.org).

OBS.: SESI students and associates are exempt from the registration fee, but they must inform that they are SESI students in the ADDITIONAL INFORMATION field during registration.

items.name: Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown I 2026
items.information:
Der Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown ist Teil des [Swisscubing Cup 2026](https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2026/). Dieser besteht aus mehreren Competitions über das ganze Jahr verteilt. 
Jeder ist willkommen, unabhängig davon ob Interesse besteht, am Swisscubing Cup Finale teilzunehmen.
**Punkte für die Qualifikation für das Swisscubing Cup 2026 Finale können bei dieser Competition nur in den folgenden Disziplinen gesammelt werden:
3BLD, 4-Blind, 5-Blind, Multiblind, FMC.**
Alle anderen Disziplinen an dieser Competition sind nicht Teil des Swisscubing Cups.

**Hinweis für Neulinge:**
Diese Competition richtet sich in erster Linie an erfahrene Speedcuber und ist entsprechend organisiert. Zwar sind Neulinge willkommen, an diesem Turnier nehmen erfahrungsgemäss nur wenige andere Einsteiger teil. Für den ersten Competition-Besuch ist ein einsteigerfreundlicheres Turnier oft die angenehmere Wahl. 

______________________________________________________________________________________________

Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown is part of the [Swisscubing Cup 2026](https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2026/), made of multiple competitions during the whole year. 
Everyone is welcome to compete, regardless of whether they are interested in taking part in the Swisscubing Cup final.

**Points for qualifying for the Swisscubing Cup 2026 Finals can only be collected at this competition in the following events: 
3BLD, 4-Blind, 5-Blind, Multiblind, FMC.**
All other events at this competition are not part of the Swisscubing Cup.

**Note for newcomers:**
This competition is primarily aimed at experienced speedcubers. While newcomers are welcome, there will be only a small number of other beginners attending this event. For a first competition, a more beginner-friendly event is often the more enjoyable choice.

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTc1ODE1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--a5b97380e04dc31adffc60a72bbfc202cab42c5f/FCD.jpg)
###Liebe Speedcuber/innen,
Wir laden Euch herzlich zu den Franconia Cube Days 2026 ein. Diese Competition ist der direkte Nachfolger der "Frankfurt Cube Days", die von 2012 bis 2024 stattfanden. Nun sind wir nicht allzu weit umgezogen in die Nähe von Nürnberg, wo wir wieder eine tolle Venue gefunden haben. Wie in der Vergangenheit möchten wir sowohl Anfängern, als auch erfahrenen Cubern eine gute Erfahrung ermöglichen. Die Events 3x3, 4x4, 5x5, 6x6 und OH werden im neuen Format "dual rounds" stattfinden, sofern das WCA Softwaresystem dies bis dahin unterstützt. Am Samstag Abend wird es wieder eine After-Comp geben, ganztägig Snacks und Getränke in der Venue und eine Cubing-Börse. Mehr dazu könnt ihr in den Tabs nachlesen. Wir feuen uns auf Euch.

###Dear competitors,
Franconia Cube Days 2026 are open to every citizen from every nation. This competition is a direct successor of the "Frankfurt Cube Days" that originated in 2012. The new venue is near Nürnberg, which has good trafic connections by plane, train or car. Our goal is to create a great experience for beginners and advanced cubers aswell. You can stay at our "After-Comp" on saturday evening to have fun and to connect with other cubers. There will be snacks and beverages at the venue and also a cube-swap shop. Please have a look at the tabs for more information. We are looking forward to see you at the FCDs 2026.

items.name: Benoni May Madness 2026
items.information:
**CubingZA** is excited to announce Benoni May Madness 2026!! Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, and pay for your ticket to confirm your entry. Please see Registration Requirements below for instructions and when registration opens.

We will be having an odd mix of main, side and blind events in this One Day, One Stop, All-Out Total Non-Stop Action-Based Competition so be sure to stick around for all sorts of weird and unique tastes of skill, fortitude and perseverance!! 




**All New Competitors**
If this is your first time competing, or the first time your child or ward is competing, please ensure to bring with ID (card, book, passport, birth certificate) so that we can verify that the name is spelled correctly, the Date of Birth is correct, and the Nationality is correct.
Please also ensure you have all the puzzles you need to compete - we do not supply puzzles for competitors. You are welcome to ask other competitors if you can borrow their puzzle for a certain event, but there is no guarantee. 


**Food and Drinks**
Mova Coffee and Sweet N' Sweet will be available from the morning selling food and drinks. They will be around for the duration of the competition so be sure to get your food in between rounds and during lunch because part of being your own champion is competing at your best and not on an empty stomach!!!

## 경상남도에서 열리는 첫 WCA 대회!

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTM3MDMxLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--580e15233f5c8e3065f8116ca9163a7eba4d3743/Picture1.png)
WCA 공인 대회에 처음 참가 하신다면, 참가 신청 전에 [첫 참가자 안내](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/HamoyeJinju2026#70113-for-new-competitors) 탭과 [자주 묻는 질문](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/HamoyeJinju2026#70112-frequently-asked-questions) 탭을 확인하십시오.

모든 참가자가 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/)을 숙지할 것을 강력히 권장합니다.

WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다.

원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [대회 참가 안내 영상](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc)을 시청하여 주십시오.

원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오.

___
## First WCA competition in Gyeongsangnam-do Province!

If this is your first official WCA competition, please read the [For New Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/HamoyeJinju2026#70113-for-new-competitors) tab and the [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/HamoyeJinju2026#70112-frequently-asked-questions) tab before registering.

All competitors are strongly encouraged to be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

Due to WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties at the organizers' request.

Please watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc) to get familiar with WCA official competitions.

Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz) to get familiar with staff duties.

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTYyNzIzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--bf638126f96e668f65b37e3ce68edb80c6d49543/upen%20(1).png)

###### Español
¡Bienvenidos al UPEN Open 2026, otra competencia en el hermoso estado de Nayarit!. Este evento emocionante y lleno de velocidad se llevará a cabo en la ciudad de Tepic los días sábado 16 y domingo 17 de mayo de 2026.

El UPEN Open 2026 reunirá a cuberos de todo el estado de Nayarit y más allá, brindándoles la oportunidad de mostrar su destreza y competir en una variedad de eventos. Tanto si eres un principiante como un profesional experimentado, este torneo ofrece una oportunidad para que todos participen y se diviertan.

Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial del Cubo. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el[ reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia.

**AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA**
En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades.
Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad.
📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

###### English
Welcome to UPEN Open 2026, another competition in the beautiful state of Nayarit! This exciting and high-speed event will take place in the city of Tepic on Saturday, May 16, and Sunday, May 17, 2026.

UPEN Open 2026 will bring together cubers from across the state of Nayarit and beyond, providing them with the opportunity to showcase their skills and compete in a variety of events. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced professional, this tournament offers a chance for everyone to participate and have fun.

This competition is recognized as an official event by the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the[ WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.

**NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY**
Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by  [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities.
By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice.
📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

## Esta competição terá Dual Rounds.
 **Resultados em direto não estão no WCA Live, deve usar [Resultados em Direto](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CNSEaoCubo2026/live)**
 
 **Em caso de problemas técnicos, o formato de Dual Rounds não será utilizado.**

Se vais competir pela primeira vez, certifica-te que lês todas as informações em [Informação Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CNSEaoCubo2026#54123-informacao-importante-important-information), [Perguntas Frequentes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CNSEaoCubo2026#54122-perguntas-frequentes-faq) e no [Regulamento WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).
Se és associado da APS tens direito a um desconto exclusivo de 20%, sabe mais [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CNSEaoCubo2025#54121-associados-aps-aps-associates).
​
## This competition will have Dual Rounds.
 **Live results won't appear on WCA Live, you should use [Live Results](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CNSEaoCubo2026/live)**
 
**There is a possibility Dual Rounds won't be used, as this format is being tested and technical issues may appear.**

If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in [Important Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CNSEaoCubo2026#68468-informacao-importante-important-information), the [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CNSEaoCubo2026#68469-perguntas-frequentes-faq) and the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).
If you're an APS associate you can take advantage of an exclusive 20% discount, find out more [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CNSEaoCubo2026#68473-associados-aps-aps-associates).

items.information:
🇧🇷 **Português**

**Bem-vindos à segunda competição de Cubo Mágico do Planalto Médio do Rio Grande do Sul !!!!**
Localizada no norte do Estado do Rio Grande do Sul, na região conhecida como Planalto Médio, a cidade de Passo Fundo destaca-se pela representatividade nas áreas médica, cultural, educacional, agrícola de precisão e tecnológica.
Por estar localizada numa região estratégica do Rio Grande do Sul e próxima do centro e oeste de Santa Catarina, o Passo Fundo Cubing 2026 promete a consolidação do Cubo Mágico em um espaço pouco alcançado até o momento, trazendo a promessa de crescimento do esporte numa verdadeira expansão para os atletas que buscam as possibilidades de participação nos campeonatos oficiais. 
Agora chegou a vez de Passo Fundo consolidar a representatividade também em um Esporte da Mente! 
Divulgar esse esporte em nível oficial, e levar aos competidores a oportunidade de participação, é o objetivo solidário da organização e dos apoiadores, especialmente da Secretaria Municipal de Educação e da Prefeitura Municipal de Passo Fundo, que apoiam o evento!
Nos vemos lá!

🇬🇧 **English:**

**Welcome to the second speedcubing competition in Passo Fundo - Rio Grande do Sul !!!!**
Located in the north of the state of Rio Grande do Sul, in the region known as "middle plateau", the city of Passo Fundo stands out due to its representation in medical, cultural, educational, precision farming and technology areas.
Since it is located in a strategical region in Rio Grande do Sul and close to the center and West of the state of Santa Catarina, this competition is a certain path to introducing speedcubing somewhere not fully reached yet, with the promise of growth to the sport, bringing a chace of participating in official competitions.
Now it is Passo Fundo's turn to reach its representation in the mind sport  too!
Spreading this sport officially and taking the opportunity to the competitors are the objectives of the organisers and supporters, especially of Secretaria Municipal de Educação and of Prefeitura Municipal de Passo Fundo, who support the event!
We will meet there!

Στη φιλόξενη και ευρύχωρη αίθουσα συνεδριάσεων του Lucy Hotel, παλιοί και νέοι, μικροί και μεγάλοι Cubers απ´ όλη τη χώρα και όχι μόνο, θα συναντηθούμε ξανά για το αγαπημένο μας χόμπυ.
Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε σε μια ακόμα γιορτή του cubing!

Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες.

Δείτε αυτά τα βίντεο για να είστε έτοιμοι:
