The Halkida Spring Open 2026 will be our next official competition of 2026 and the first ever to be held in the beautiful city of Halkida!

In the welcoming conference hall of the Lucy Hotel, cubers from all over the country and beyond—young and old, new and experienced—will come together once again for our favorite hobby.
Grab your cubes, get ready, read the rules, and join us for another cubing celebration!

Please read the following tabs very carefully!

### 🇧🇷 Português
Campeonato Mineiro 2026, em parceria com a Associação Mineira de Cultura Nipo-Brasileira!
Atenção: Esta competição terá limite de competitores. Inscreva-se somente se você tem certeza que irá participar.
Em caso de desistência, por favor entrar em contato com a organização.

Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CampeonatoMineiro2026/register). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazê-lo [neste vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410).

Se você estiver participando pela primeira vez, assista [este vídeo](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) para aprender a competir. Leia o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian) antes da competição. Competidores participando pela primeira vez precisam apresentar na competição um documento oficial com nome, data de nascimento e nacionalidade. Sugerimos que você chegue 30 minutos antes do horário da modalidade em que vai competir.

O valor da taxa de inscrição é de R$50. As inscrições deverão ser pagas antecipadamente via PIX:
[associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com)

Enviar o comprovante do pagamento, junto com o nome do competidor, para o email: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com).
A inscrição só será confirmada no site da WCA após confirmação do pagamento.

Inscrições no local serão aceitas apenas para a modalidade 3x3x3.

Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a equipe de organização, a WCA e seus parceiros utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais.

### 🇺🇸 English
Attention: This competition has a limit on competitors. Only sign up if you are sure you will participate.
In case of withdrawal, please contact the organization.

Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CampeonatoMineiro2026/register) tab. If you have any problem registering, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410).

If this is your first time competing, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) to learn how to compete. Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) before the competition. Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, date of birth and nationality. We suggest you arrive 30 minutes before the event you're competing in is scheduled to begin.

The registration fee is R$50. Entries must be paid in advance via PIX:
[associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com)

Send proof of payment, along with the competitor's name, to the email: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com).
Registration will only be confirmed on the WCA website after confirmation of payment.

Registrations on the spot will be accepted only for the 3x3x3 event.

By registering, you authorize the organization team, the WCA and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes.

## Another competition to be held at UC Berkeley!

* Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors.

- The competition will begin at the scheduled start time.

# **VAQUITA MORELIA 2026**
**Español**
Ven y cubea con nosotros en la hermosa ciudad de la cantera rosada Morelia , Michoacan; un torneo pequeño pero con grandes animos para seguir creciendo nuestra hermosa comunidad.
Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la **Asociación Mundial de Cubos**. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA]
(https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia.
**AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA**
En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades.
Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad.
📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

**English**
Come and enjoy cubing with us in the beautiful pink quarry city of Morelia, Michoacán; a small competition with great enthusiasm to keep growing our wonderful community.
This competition is recognized as an official competition of the **World Cube Association**. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the[ WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) prior to competition.
Come and cube with us in the beautiful city of Morelia, Michoacan, known for its pink quarry stone. It's a small tournament, but with great enthusiasm to continue growing our wonderful community.
**NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY**
Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by  [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities.
By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice.
📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

items.information:
English version is below
Deutsch:
Wir freuen uns sehr euch Langenstein City Blind Open 2026 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können.

Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Simon Praschl, Martin Fröhlich, Philipp Leimer und Thomas Strasser und delegiert von Pranjal Khan, Fabian Staber und Jan Křížka. Diesmal findet die Competition in der Eisstockhalle in Langenstein statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt.

Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen!

Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen.

Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich!

English:
We are happy to announce the Langenstein City Blind Open 2026 as an official WCA Competition.

The speedcubing competition is organised by Simon Praschl, Martin Fröhlich, Philipp Leimer and Thomas Strasser and delegated by Pranjal Khan, Fabian Staber and Jan Křížka. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings.

The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations.

Every Competitor can bring one guest.

venue.name: [Museo de Arte e Historia de Guanajuato](https://maps.app.goo.gl/9SfTK7qDGeZjAWr9A)

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTYyMjgzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--ce5023c17fc9bf649fbe7e7c137c67c69bebbf8b/CaminosLeon.jpg)

##### *🎵"Bonito León, Guanajuato, la feria con su jugada, allí se apuesta la vida y se respeta al que gana..."🎶*

## Caminos de Guanajuato – León 2026

La ruta **"Caminos de Guanajuato"** comienza su recorrido en **León, Guanajuato**, un lugar que refleja el carácter y la riqueza cultural de nuestro estado, donde la historia, la tradición y la vida cotidiana se entrelazan en cada rincón. Este torneo forma parte de una travesía que celebra no solo el speedcubing, sino también la identidad cultural de nuestro estado, conectando distintas sedes bajo un mismo espíritu competitivo y festivo.
En cada parada, la música de José Alfredo Jiménez acompaña simbólicamente el camino. Sus canciones, que han dado voz al sentir guanajuatense, inspiran esta edición dedicada a León.

El **Guanajuato Rubik’s Team** estará encantado de recibirte con los brazos abiertos para compartir la pasión por el cubo y, al mismo tiempo, invitarte a conocer más sobre la historia del estado, sus municipios y el legado cultural que ha trascendido fronteras. Queremos que tu experiencia vaya más allá de la competencia: que sea también un encuentro con nuestras raíces, nuestras historias y nuestra música.

Te esperamos en León para seguir construyendo juntos los **"Caminos de Guanajuato"**.

Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la **Asociación Mundial de Cubos**. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia.

**AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA**
En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades.
Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad.
📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

## Caminos de Guanajuato – León 2026

The "Caminos de Guanajuato" route begins in **León, Guanajuato**, a place that reflects the character and cultural richness of our state, where history, tradition, and daily life intertwine in every corner. This tournament is part of a journey that celebrates not only speedcubing but also the cultural identity of our state, connecting different locations under the same competitive and festive spirit.

At each stop, the music of José Alfredo Jiménez symbolically accompanies the journey. His songs, which have given voice to the Guanajuato spirit, inspire this edition dedicated to León.

The **Guanajuato Rubik’s Team** will be delighted to welcome you with open arms to share the passion for the cube and, at the same time, invite you to learn more about the history of the state, its municipalities, and the cultural legacy that has transcended borders. We want your experience to go beyond the competition: we want it to also be an encounter with our roots, our stories, and our music.

We look forward to seeing you in León to continue building the **"Caminos de Guanajuato"** together.

This competition is recognized as an official competition of the **World Cube Association**. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the[ WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) prior to competition.

**NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY**
Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by  [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities.
By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice.
📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

items.information:
# ENGLISH

**Mandatory Competition tutorial**

All competitors are required to complete the official competitor tutorial before being allowed to participate in the competition. This requirement applies to everyone, not only newcomers.
Competitors who do not attend the tutorial will not be permitted to compete.

**Special Competition Format**

This competition will be held using a special format in which all events run simultaneously.
Each competitor will have a 45-minute cumulative limit to complete attempts in any events they choose.

**Povinný tutoriál pro soutěžící**

Všichni závodníci musí před začátkem soutěže absolvovat oficiální tutoriál. Tato povinnost platí pro všechny, nejen pro nováčky.
Závodníkům, kteří se tutoriálu nezúčastní, nebude umožněno soutěžit.

**Speciální formát soutěže**

Tato soutěž bude probíhat ve speciálním formátu, ve kterém všechny disciplíny běží zároveň.
Každý soutěžící má k dispozici 45 minut, během kterých může skládat libovolné disciplíny podle vlastního výběru.

items.name: Teknostallen 2026
items.information:
### 🇳🇴 Teknostallen 2026

Gjør deg klar for en fin kubehelg når vi inviterer til konkurranse i Teknostallen i Trondheim 28.–29. mars! Dette blir en helg med ekte konkurransestemning, offisielle tider og masse energi. Arrangementet er for ALLE – enten du løser kuben på 3 sekunder eller 3 minutter, og enten du er 7 eller 70 år. Her skal både nybegynnere og erfarne speedcubers samles for å dele lidenskapen for kuben og jakten på nye personlige rekorder.

Konkurransen går over to dager inne i den spektakulære tropiske hagen i Teknostallen, en helt unik ramme for raske fingre og raske hoder. Det konkurreres i mange ulike grener, fra klassisk 3x3 til flere andre varianter. Dette blir en helg fylt med mestring, spenning og ekte kubeglede.

Man går inn hovedinngangen på Teknostallen, og venteområdet kommer til å være under messaninen, mens konkurransene foregår oppe på messaninen. Det er gode muligheter for å kjøpe både mat og drikke fra de ulike plassene på bygget som Mellom, Glød og Snurr. 

---

### 🇺🇸 Teknostallen 2026

Get ready for a great cube weekend as we invite you to a competition at Teknostallen in Trondheim on March 28–29. This will be a weekend filled with real competition atmosphere, official timing and plenty of energy. The event is for EVERYONE – whether you solve the cube in 3 seconds or 3 minutes, and whether you are 7 or 70 years old. Both beginners and experienced speedcubers will gather to share their passion for cubing and the pursuit of new personal bests.

The competition takes place over two days inside the spectacular tropical garden at Teknostallen, a truly unique setting for fast fingers and fast minds. Multiple events will be held, from the classic 3x3 to several other variations. Expect a weekend filled with achievement, excitement and true cube joy.

Enter through the main entrance of Teknostallen. The waiting area will be located under the mezzanine, while the competitions take place on the mezzanine level. There will be great opportunities to purchase food and drinks from the various venues in the building, including Mellom, Glød and Snurr.

**Thông cáo về quay phim chụp ảnh**

Ban tổ chức và/hoặc các đơn vị truyền thông có thể sẽ quay phim, chụp ảnh làm tư liệu về giải đấu. Khi có mặt tại hội trường giải đấu, **bạn công nhận rằng bạn đã được thông báo về việc quay phim, chụp ảnh tại giải đấu, và hiểu rõ rằng tư liệu hình ảnh này sẽ được sử dụng cho mọi mục đích cần thiết của Hiệp hội Rubik Việt Nam, các tổ chức đại diện và các đối tác, nhà tài trợ liên quan. Bạn đồng thời cũng đồng ý cho phép Hiệp hội Rubik Việt Nam, các tổ chức đại diện và các đối tác, nhà tài trợ liên quan toàn quyền vĩnh viễn sử dụng những hình ảnh có diện mạo và/hoặc giọng nói của bạn cho mọi mục đích cần thiết.** Nếu bạn không đồng ý với các điều khoản trên, xin vui lòng không có mặt tại hội trường giải đấu.
________________________________________________________________

**Notice on photography and filming**
The organizers and/or media organizations may perform filming and photography at the competition for usage as photographic material of the competition. By being present at the competition premises,  **you acknowledge that you have been duly informed of any filming and photography that might take place at the competition, and fully acknowledge that the material may be used for any and all necessary purposes by the Vietnam Cube Association (VNCA) and its representatives, partners and affiliated sponsors. You also grant full, perpetual consent for VNCA and its representatives, partners and affiliated sponsors to use video and photographic material that contains your likeness and/or voice for any and all necessary purposes.** If you do not agree with the above terms, please do not be present at the competition premises.

items.information:
Жарыс қайырымдылық мақсатында ұйымдастырылады. Жарыстан жиналған барлық қаражат туа біткен екіжақты құлақ атрезиясы мен микротия диагнозы қойылған Данелияның еміне бағытталады.
Данелия дерлік естімейді, сөйлеуі қиын, бұл оның жалпы дамуына әсер етуде. Қазіргі таңда ол сүйек өткізгіштігі бар есту аппаратын қолданады, алайда ол жиі бұзылып, баланың белсенді өміріне төтеп бере алмайды. Биыл Данелия 5 жасқа толады, және медициналық көрсеткіштер бойынша оған бас сүйегіне имплантация немесе каналопластика операциясы қажет.
АҚШ дәрігері ұсынған каналопластика операциясы Данелияның есту қабілетін қалпына келтіріп, есту жолын кеңейтуге және өмір бойы есту аппаратына тәуелді болмауға мүмкіндік беруі мүмкін.
Жиналған қаражат тікелей қолма-қол берілмейді. Барлық жарналар ресми түрде «ZHALAIRI» қайырымдылық қоры арқылы қабылданып, Данелияның еміне заңды және ашық түрде бағытталады.
Жарыс  Алтын сауда орталығында ,3 қабаттары  холлда өтеді.
Сіздің қолдауыңыз Данелияға толыққанды өмір сүруге үлкен үміт сыйлайды.
Баршаңызды қайырымдылық жарысына қатысуға және қолдау көрсетуге шақырамыз

English:
The competition is organized for charitable purposes. All funds raised during the event will be directed toward the treatment of Danelia, who has been diagnosed with congenital bilateral ear atresia and microtia.
Danelia can barely hear and has difficulty speaking, which affects her overall development. Currently, she uses a bone-conduction hearing device; however, it frequently breaks down and cannot withstand an active child’s lifestyle. This year, Danelia turns 5 years old, and according to medical indications, she requires either a skull implantation procedure or canaloplasty surgery.
The canaloplasty surgery recommended by a U.S. doctor may help restore Danelia’s hearing, widen the ear canal, and allow her to live without lifelong dependence on a hearing device.
The collected funds will not be handed directly in cash. All donations will be officially received through the «ZHALAIRI» charitable foundation and will be legally and transparently allocated to Danelia’s treatment.
The competition will take place at Altyn Shopping Center, 3rd floor hall.
Your support gives Danelia great hope for a full and happy life.
We invite everyone to participate in the charity competition and show their support.

items.name: Kalvskinnet Kubing 2026
items.information:
## 🇳🇴 Informasjon
Velkommen til Kalvskinnet Kubing 2026! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta.

### On The Spot Registreringer
Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KalvskinnetKubing2026/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen.

### Førstegangsdeltakere
Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KalvskinnetKubing2026#70615-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors).


---

## 🇺🇸 Information
Welcome to Kalvskinnet Kubing 2026! The competition is open to all who wish to compete.

### On The Spot Registration
Competitors may register on the spot. We strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KalvskinnetKubing2026/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot.

### First-Time Competitors
First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. # 9년 만에 열리는 제주 대회!
WCA 공인 대회에 처음 참가 하신다면, 참가 신청 전에 [첫 참가자 안내](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Jeju2026#67003-for-new-competitors) 탭과 [자주 묻는 질문](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Jeju2026#67002-frequently-asked-questions) 탭을 확인하십시오.

모든 참가자가 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/)을 숙지할 것을 강력히 권장합니다.

WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다.

원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [대회 참가 안내 영상](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc)을 시청하여 주십시오.

원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오.

___

# The first WCA competition in Jeju since 2017!
If this is your first official WCA competition, please read the [For New Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Jeju2026#67003-for-new-competitorshttps://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Jeju2026#67003-for-new-competitors) tab and the [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Jeju2026#67002-frequently-asked-questions) tab before registering.

All competitors are strongly encouraged to be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

Due to WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties at the organizers' request.

Please watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc) to get familiar with WCA official competitions.

Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz) to get familiar with staff duties.

items.information:
### Davis' first ever competition featuring *blindfolded events*, *fewest moves*, and *clock* - Don't DNF!



![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTMyODc3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--43a4741aef31f26a98dc1e8b9ffd2345e0737df2/image.png)

##### This competition will be specializing in quiet events and will not have 3x3 or typical events found in traditional competitions. 
*New competitors are welcome — for Clock solvers, we highly encourage you to explore and take on the challenge of blindfolded and fewest moves!*

- All attendees under the age of 18 are required to be accompanied by a parent or guardian.
- Competition attendees may **appear on livestream and media**.
- Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.

**This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [Speedcubeshop](https://speedcubeshop.com/).**

The competition features Clock as the main event, alongside other official events: 3x3, 2x2, 6x6, Skewb, 3x3 Blindfolded, 4x4 Blindfolded, and Fewest Moves (FMC).

The competition will also include several unofficial events: 3×3 Supersolve, Master Magic, Cap On Pen, and the Mystery Event (limited to 6 participants). Participation in these events is completely optional—please visit the Unofficial Events tab for full details, rules, and registration instructions.

We encourage all competitors and guests to carefully read through the information tabs to stay updated on the schedule, event rules, venue guidelines, and registration requirements. This will help ensure a smooth and enjoyable experience for everyone.

**ENGLISH**
See the registration requirements on the main tab for detailed information.

Also, all competitors should be aware of [the WCA regulations.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)

It is important to carefully write your name, birth date, and other information properly. Otherwise, your registration will not be accepted. If this is your second competition, you must have already claimed your WCA ID.

items.name: Love is Blind UMBC 2026
items.information:
**Blindfolded Events Only**

The only events held at this competition are blindfolded events, which require a significant amount of concentration. All attendees, including competitors and guests, are asked to remain AS QUIET AS POSSIBLE throughout the day to allow competitors to concentrate.

**Note for New Competitors**

Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they can solve puzzles blindfolded, this competition is not the traditional WCA competition experience. Please consider registering for another competition, such as [UMBC Winter 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UMBCWinter2026), if this one isn't for you.

Nesta competição estaremos com uma campanha beneficente que visa a ajuda para os mais necessitados. Também teremos premiação para as 3 pessoas que mais doarem durante os dias de campeonato! Assim, além de nos divertimos, contribuímos para a construção de um mundo melhor. Saiba mais na pagina [Campanha Beneficente](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CuritibaContraoTempo2026#64648-campanha-beneficente)


💵 **PREMIAÇÃO EM DINHEIRO** 💵
Nesta competição, estaremos realizando a premiação em dinheiro para o pódio da modalidade principal do campeonato, o Clock. Todas as informações estão dispostas na página [Premiação em Dinheiro](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CuritibaContraoTempo2026#64649-premiacao-em-dinheiro)

Se você estiver participando pela primeira vez, assista este [vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU) para aprender a competir. Leia o [regulamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) da WCA antes da competição. Competidores participando pela primeira vez precisam apresentar na competição um documento oficial com nome, data de nascimento e nacionalidade. Sugerimos que você chegue 30 minutos antes do horário da primeira modalidade em que vai competir.

Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a ABRACM, a WCA e seus parceiros utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais.

Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para as modalidades 'Iniciante (primeira competição)', e "Feminino" que tomarão como referência a classificação geral na modalidade '3x3x3'.


🇬🇧 **English:**
Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the Register tab. If you have any problem registering, watch this [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4yo7IqbcgOA&t).


❗️❗️**IMPORTANT**
This competition will feature a charity campaign to help those most in need. We'll also have prizes for the three people who donate the most during the competition! This way, we'll not only have fun, but we'll also contribute to building a better world. Learn more on the [Charity Campaign](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CuritibaContraoTempo2026#64648-campanha-beneficente) page.


💵 **CASH PRIZES** 💵
In this competition, we will be awarding cash prizes for the podium finishers in the main event, Clock. All information is available on the [Cash Prizes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CuritibaContraoTempo2026#64649-premiacao-em-dinheiro) page.


If this is your first time competing, watch this [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8) to learn how to compete. Please read the WCA [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, date of birth and nationality. We suggest you arrive 30 minutes before the first event you're competing in is scheduled to begin.

By registering, you authorize ABRACM, WCA, and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes.

We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards to the events 'Beginner (first competition)', and "female" which will consider the final ranking in the '3x3x3' event.

items.information:
## VOLUNTEERING
Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8).

If any parents are willing to help judge or run, please watch the above video if you have not been a judge/runner at previous competitions. We greatly appreciate all assistance during the competition and more volunteers helping out during the competition helps to stay on schedule and not run behind.

## Sponsorship

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjY5MTksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--043850cb450564025444969edb4c94d522019cb1/image.png)

A big thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za) who will co host this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to buy the different speedcubes they have on offer.
You can also go to Cubestuff.co.za to order a variety of cubes and equipment online.

The **Legacy Centurion Hotel** will have discounted rates for accommodation for those wanting to overnight at the hotel during the weekend of the competition. Be sure to keep a lookout for more information in this regard.
Their restaurant will also be open for meals and refreshments during the competition. Please see the Legacy Centurion Hotel tab for more information.

## NOTICE FOR COMPETITORS
Be sure to be ready to compete in any of your scheduled events at least 30 minutes before the scheduled starting time.

## NOTICE OF FILMING
Please note that there will be filming and photography at this event. You therefore consent to your image being used by CubingZA and its partners in their marketing and social media platforms by attending.

## About CubingZA
CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.
If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to improve competitive speedcubing in the country, please get in touch.

##### *English version is below*

#### **Deutsch:**

Wir freuen uns sehr euch Vienna Winter 2026 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können.

Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Julian Ostdal, Noah Kirrane, Simon Praschl und Sebastian Feichtinger und delegiert von Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan und Florian Truckenthanner. Diesmal findet die Competition im Jugendgästehaus Brigittenau statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt.

Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen!

Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen.


Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich!

-----

#### **English:**

We are happy to announce the Vienna Winter 2026 as an official WCA Competition.

The speedcubing competition is organised by Julian Ostadal, Noah Kirrane, Simon Praschl and Sebastian Feichtinger and delegated by Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan and Florian Truckenthanner. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings.

The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations.

Every Competitor can bring one guest.

##### Español
​
**¡Bienvenidos a Contrarreloj - San Andrés Cholula 2026!**
​
San Andrés Cholula se convierte en el campo de batalla de la velocidad,
donde **no compites contra otros… compites contra el tiempo**.
Cada décima decide, cada centésima define.

3 rondas de las categorías más rápidas.
El reto más grande: **vencer al reloj**.
​
Esta competencia es posible gracias al apoyo del **Municipo de San Andrés Cholula** y a la **Presidenta Municipal Guadalupe Cuautle Torres**.
​
 Contrarreloj - San Andrés Cholula 2026 es una competencia oficial de la WCA por lo que todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [Reglamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/).
​
**AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA**
En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing, Team Puebla y el equipo organizador con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades.
Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen.

##### English
​
**¡Welcome to Contrarreloj - San Andrés Cholula 2026!**
​
San Andrés Cholula becomes the battlefield of speed,
where **you don’t compete against others… you compete against time**.
Every tenth matters, every hundredth defines.

3 rounds of the fastest events.
The greatest challenge: **beat the clock**.
​
This competition is made possible thanks to the support of the **Municipality of San Andrés Cholula** and **Municipal President Guadalupe Cuautle Torres**.
​
 Contrarreloj - San Andrés Cholula 2026 is a WCA official competition, hence all participants should be familiar with the [Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations).

**NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY**
Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing, Team Puebla and the organization team for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities.
By attending, you authorize the use of your image.

WCA 공인 대회에 처음 참가 하신다면, 참가 신청 전에 [첫 참가자 안내](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SeoulWinter2026#66998-for-new-competitors) 탭과 [자주 묻는 질문](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SeoulWinter2026#66997-frequently-asked-questions) 탭을 확인하십시오.

모든 참가자가 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/)을 숙지할 것을 강력히 권장합니다.

WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다.

원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [대회 참가 안내 영상](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc)을 시청하여 주십시오.

원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오.

___

If this is your first official WCA competition, please read the [For New Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SeoulWinter2026#66998-for-new-competitors) tab and the [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SeoulWinter2026#66997-frequently-asked-questions) tab before registering.

All competitors are strongly encouraged to be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

Due to WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties at the organizers' request.

Please watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc) to get familiar with WCA official competitions.

Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz) to get familiar with staff duties.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTQ2NzQ3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--fee206de225e7d6b6472e021ba9c9e58b1ac5a36/amcm_logo_300px.png)
### 🇧🇷 Português
Atenção: Esta competição terá limite de competitores. Inscreva-se somente se você tem certeza que irá participar.
Em caso de desistência, por favor entrar em contato com a organização.

Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IFMGBetimOpen2026/register). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazê-lo [neste vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410).

Se você estiver participando pela primeira vez, assista [este vídeo](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) para aprender a competir. Leia o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian) antes da competição. Competidores participando pela primeira vez precisam apresentar na competição um documento oficial com nome, data de nascimento e nacionalidade. Sugerimos que você chegue 30 minutos antes do horário da modalidade em que vai competir.

O valor da taxa de inscrição é de R$35. As inscrições deverão ser pagas antecipadamente via PIX:
[associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com)

Enviar o comprovante do pagamento, junto com o nome do competidor, para o email: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com).
A inscrição só será confirmada no site da WCA após confirmação do pagamento.

Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a equipe de organização, a WCA e seus parceiros utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais.

### 🇺🇸 English
Attention: This competition has a limit on competitors. Only sign up if you are sure you will participate.
In case of withdrawal, please contact the organization.

Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IFMGBetimOpen2026/register) tab. If you have any problem registering, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410).

If this is your first time competing, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) to learn how to compete. Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) before the competition. Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, date of birth and nationality. We suggest you arrive 30 minutes before the event you're competing in is scheduled to begin.

The registration fee is R$35. Entries must be paid in advance via PIX:
[associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com)

Send proof of payment, along with the competitor's name, to the email: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com).
Registration will only be confirmed on the WCA website after confirmation of payment.

By registering, you authorize the organization team, the WCA and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes.

ekipa Cube Factory pragnie serdecznie zaprosić na pierwszą imprezę nowego roku pod szyldem Cube Factory!

Ze względu na duży limit kumulowany dla konkurencji 4x4x4 Blindfolded oraz 5x5x5 Blindfolded doświadczeni zawodnicy mają możliwość rozpoczęcia swoich prób w trakcie trwania rundy. Dear All,
Cube Factory Team invites you to the first Cube Factory competition of the New Year!

We're back to the crazy high cut-offs and limits so that you can achieve your dreamt-of average in some less popular events!

See you there!

**IMPORTANT**

Due to the high cumulative limit for the 4x4x4 Blindfolded and 5x5x5 Blindfolded events, experienced competitors may begin their attempts later in the round. In such a case, pursuant to point 2u2 of the WCA regulations, the competitor's cumulative limit will be reduced by the time relative to how much they were late

items.information:
A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz.

**ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição que não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades.
**ATENÇÃO:** Devido ao tamanho do local da competição, apenas um acompanhante será permitido por competidor. Façamos a competição ser possível para todos os competidores!

---

Registration is open to any person, from any country.

With a view to the smooth running of the competition, by registering for a category, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler in that category (as provided for in the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming heavy for just a few. At least two groups were made in each modality. In one of the groups you compete and in the other you help to scramble or judge.

**ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of its events.
**ATTENTION:** Due to the size of the competition's venue, only one guest will be allowed per competitor. Please do not bring more guests than the allowed quantity, let's make the competition possible for all competitors!
